title: Triptych Video Canon
subtitle: A three-panel moving-image canon for Stories, Reels, YouTube, GitHub, and eventual product surfaces.

web_media.note: Generated landing-page proxies are intentionally lightweight and lossy; artifacts are part of the aesthetic.

prompts.text: Build a triptych / three-video-panel Instagram Story-style creative device from manually exported Photos videos.
Use a Baroque/classical canon or round structure: clips enter on the left, move to the middle, move to the right, then leave.
Treat different clip lengths as useful imperfections instead of normalizing them away.
Support both cumulative text direction and editor-like movement/reordering.
When explicitly authorized, support opt-in Photos library ingestion so the canon can keep living without manual video editing.
For the first postable iteration, begin with the earliest video in Photos and let each clip's own length lead the canon cadence.
Keep the device light on its feet with fast draft exports, hide/show controls for specific clips, selected-folder imports, and explicit audio modes.

Make the public surface media-first: first load shows only the dynamic triptych videos, with prompts, clip order, hiding, audio, exports, and settings tucked behind a tap-open settings drawer; wide/fullscreen fills as three equal panels, narrow/minimized behaves like a vertical Story.

Once the triptych fills, keep it filled: each cadence step is a round held by the longest active clip, with shorter clips looping in place until the round resolves and clips shift left-to-right together.
Add MIDI-like video direction effects: all panels forward, all panels reverse, or all panels ping-pong forward then backward.
Scale to the full Photos video library by cataloging all videos as lightweight metadata, then staging and rendering only small selected editions.
Source choice matters: support a deliberate Finder folder or Photos album/collection for better selected editions instead of relying on the oldest automatic import.
Add per-panel audio control and export-time brightness/tone balancing so the canon can be mixed and normalized without manual editing.
Use lightweight lossy web proxies for the living landing page; artifacts and distortions from compression are acceptable material rather than errors.
Make the next full-steam layer a flash copy: a lightweight, manipulatable, remixable selected-edition sync surface between the private Photos library and the public/static triptych.

Treat Photos albums like accidents, ballerina, noonlight, porn, and glitche as edition configurations of the same canon engine: source selection, order, direction, audio, tone, proxy recipe, landing page, and export targets should live in text.

Correct the ballerina edition model: ballerina danse is raw material, while ballerina whole is the arrangement model, a Picasso/cubist structural target for reconstructing figure fragments across panels.
Make panel arrangement one of the device qualities: the canon voices stay left/middle/right internally, but the triptych surface can rearrange which voice appears in each visible column.

Treat Ballerina Whole as a sketch for reconfiguring the triptych panels: Ballerina Danse is raw material, the work title is Ballerina Danse Recomposition, Noonlight and Accidents follow the structural-recomposition family, and Glitche/Porn share a signal-damage family.

Move album-specific visual arrangements into text maps: Ballerina uses score_cells from Ballerina Whole, Accidents uses fracture_cells for rupture/delayed consequence, and the shared engine stays lightweight and reversible.

Make arrangement maps public-readable without exposing the source library: sync a sanitized arrangement_score into the landing page, flash-copy receipt, and index so the authored score is visible behind settings.

photos_catalog.note: Use catalog_photos.py for library-scale interaction without staging every source video.

editor.clip_order: filename by default; add a clips array to pin a deliberate order
